transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

I guess… mostly other people pushed me to come. HR at work and my sister keep saying I’ve gotten too thin. I don’t really see it that way—I just think my suits fit better, sharper. My weight has been dropping since the divorce, though.
Do you think you are underweight?

I mean… I know everyone’s making a big deal about it. But I’m still jogging, still covering my territory, still hitting my numbers at work. So no, it doesn’t really feel like I’m underweight in some dangerous way.
Are you afraid of gaining weight?

I don’t know if I’d call it afraid, exactly. But… if I get on the scale after a client dinner or a weekend away and it’s even a pound up, I do get this kind of panic. Like I’m losing control. Then I start figuring out how to cut back the next day.
Do you ever eat an amount of food that feels excessive to you in a short period of time?
Not really. I mean… sometimes a meal feels like too much if it’s heavier than I planned, but I wouldn’t say I’m eating a huge amount in a short time.
Do you ever make yourself vomit after eating?
No… I don’t do that.
How much weight have you lost since your divorce?
I haven’t really wanted to put a number on it. It’s… been dropping since the divorce. HR and my sister keep saying I’ve gotten too thin, but I mostly just notice my suits fit cleaner, sharper.
Is your fear of gaining weight the main reason you restrict what you eat?

Yeah… I guess that’s a big part of it. If the scale is even up a pound after, like, a client dinner or a weekend out, I get this panic feeling… like I’m losing control. Then I start thinking about how to cut back the next day.
Do you ever feel a loss of control while eating?
I don’t know… not really? I usually feel pretty aware of what I’m eating. It’s more like I’m trying to keep it controlled, I guess.
Do you ever have episodes where you eat a normal amount of food, but still feel like you've lost control?
Not really… I mean, if I eat a normal meal, I might feel uncomfortable about it after, but I don’t think I’d call it losing control. It’s more like I’m aware of it the whole time.
Do you ever eat an amount of food that feels normal to others but excessive to you?
I’m not sure. Maybe sometimes a regular amount feels like a lot to me, but… I don’t know if I’d call it excessive.
Do you ever eat an amount of food that feels normal to others but excessive to you in a short period of time?
I don’t really know. Maybe what feels like a lot to me isn’t that much to someone else, but I wouldn’t say it happens in some… episode or anything.
Do you ever feel like you've eaten an amount of food that's excessive to you?
Sometimes it feels that way, yeah… but I’m not sure if it would really count as excessive. It’s more just… more than I’m comfortable with.
Do you think you would stop restricting your food intake if you were at a weight that other people considered normal?

I don’t know if that would change much. Even now, most days I just keep it to coffee in the morning, maybe a protein bar while I’m out on calls, and then something small at night… like chicken without rice. If I eat a full meal, it kind of feels like I ruined the whole day.
Do you ever feel like you've eaten an amount of food that's excessive to you in a short period of time, even if it doesn't seem like a lot to others?
I guess… sometimes it feels like too much to me, even if it probably wouldn’t look like much. But I don’t know if I’d call it a short-period thing. It’s more just… I get uncomfortable with it.
Do you ever have episodes where you feel like you're eating much more than you planned?
I’m not really sure. I mean… sometimes I eat more than I meant to, but I don’t know if I’d call it “much more.” It’s just more than I planned, I guess.
Do you ever feel like you're eating much more than you planned in a short amount of time?
Not really in a short amount of time, no. I mean… I might eat more than I meant to, but it doesn’t feel like some big episode or anything.
Is your fear of gaining weight very distressing to you?

Yeah… it can be. If the scale is even a pound higher after, like, a client dinner or a weekend out, I kind of panic. I start thinking I’m losing control and planning how I’m going to cut back the next day.
Is your goal to be as thin as possible?

I don’t know if I’d put it like that… not “as thin as possible,” exactly. It’s more like, before a meeting or a date, I’ll look in the mirror and just fixate on my stomach or my face. If I think I look soft, I feel like people are going to see me as sloppy or weak.
Do you ever have episodes where you eat what you would consider a large amount of food in a short period of time?
I don’t think so. I mean, not like… a big amount all at once. Sometimes I eat more than I wanted, but I wouldn’t call it an episode.
Do you ever have episodes where you feel like you're eating much more than you planned?
Maybe… I mean, sometimes I eat more than I meant to. But I don’t know if I’d call it “much more.” It’s not something I really think of that way.
